description.narrative: Support is provided to two UN Women-managed trust funds to support progress on gender equality and women's empowerment in in line with Goal 5 of the SDGs. A contribution is also made to the Office of the President of the UN General Assembly to support the day-to-day operations of the Office. Grants are also made to other UN projects such as the Joint SDG Fund that reflect the priorities of Ireland's international development policy, A Better World.

The UN Trust Fund for Ending Violence Against Women works to achieve a life free of violence for women and girls. Women Count advances the production, availability, accessibility and use of quality data and statistics on key aspects of gender equality and women’s empowerment. The Office of the President of the General Assembly is supported to carry out its administrative, logistical and management functions. Th Joint SDG Fund objectives include integrated multi-sectoral policies to accelerate SDG achievement; greater scope and scale of activities to achieve the SDGs; and leveraging additional financing to accelerate SDG achievement. The UN Multi-Partner Trust Fund for Colombia, which also receives funding from the Stability Fund, was established to provide support for the implementation of the Colombia peace agreement, signed in late 2016.
